evidence: Body pp1022 (I Vesp.) and 1032 (II Vesp.) of Communia 'Plurimorum martyrum' print only 'H Sanctorum meritis (LHym 277)'; no rubric names LHym 279. Hymn index p1222 has 'Sanctorum meritis 1' and '2' (this row, LHym 279, gregobase:18017 = mode 4, Solesmes 1983). Option 1 holder gregobase:4229 = 'Sanctorum meritis' mode 2, Solesmes 1934 (the LHym 277 melody). Index-only second melody rule (intake #26) applies. Note: the brief cited p1023 as I Vesp.; actually I Vesp. hymn rubric is on p1022 (p1023 is Communia).
